text: {"lessons":["I will make sell decisions based on a stock’s outlook and my plan, not simply to avoid realizing a loss or because its price is below my average cost.","The account’s ups and downs over these months are a reminder not to overreact to short-term price moves; I will trade only when I have a clear reason.","I will keep my portfolio diversified and aligned with my ten-year apartment goal, and ensure purchases stay within the cash I have available."]}
